title: Proclamation No. 343, s. 2012
text:
PROCLAMATION NO. 343

DECLARING TUESDAY, 28 FEBRUARY 2012, AS A SPECIAL (NON-WORKING) DAY IN THE CITY OF ESCALANTE, PROVINCE OF NEGROS OCCIDENTAL

WHEREAS, Tuesday, 28 February 2012, marks the 11 th Charter Day anniversary of the City of Escalante, Negros Occidental;

WHEREAS, it is but fitting and proper that the people of the City of Escalante, Negros Occidental be given full opportunity to celebrate and participate in the occasion with appropriate ceremonies.

NOW, THEREFORE, I, PAQUITO N. OCHOA JR., Executive Secretary, by authority of His Excellency, BENIGNO S. AQUINO III, do hereby declare Tuesday, 28 February 2012, as a special (non-working) day in the City of Escalante, Negros Occidental.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have hereunto set my hand and caused the seal of the Republic of the Philippines to be affixed.

Done in the City of Manila, this 22 nd day of February, in the year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twelve.

By the President:

(Sgd.) PAQUITO N. OCHOA, JR. Executive Secretary
